script.text: Eight fourteen PM. You're one level away from beating the game. And the screen goes black.
So does the TV. The fridge stops humming. Every light in the house, gone. At the same moment.
You grab your phone. Dead. Not low battery. Dead. You try the flashlight in the kitchen drawer. Dead too.

Outside, the whole street is dark. A car rolls to a stop, without a sound. The streetlights. The traffic lights. The whole city, all the way to the horizon. Black. Somewhere, a car alarm should be going off. It isn't. Nothing is.
Then you look up. And for the first time in your life, you see the Milky Way.
The first night feels like camping. But a city runs on electricity the way your body runs on blood. And the clock started the second the lights went out.
